items.definition: Zaman, sıra ve amaç ilişkisine dayanan on cümle tamamlama sorusu.

questions.prompt: The museum extended its opening hours so that ----.
options: the exhibition would be closed earlier in the evening
fewer visitors had queued outside
the guards were able to leave early
tickets were made more expensive
more visitors could see the exhibition
questions.explanationTR: «So that» bir AMAÇ bildirir: çalışma saatleri uzatıldı, böylece daha fazla ziyaretçi sergiyi görebildi: (E). (A) ve (C) saatleri kısaltma sonucunu anlatır. (B) daha az ziyaretçi amaçla çelişir. (D) bilet fiyatı artışı saat uzatmanın amacı olamaz.

options: the last employee had left the building
the last employee leaves the building
the last employee will leave the building
the last employee is leaving the building
the last employee would have left the building
questions.explanationTR: Ana cümle geçmiş zamandadır (waited); önce biten eylem past perfect ile verilir: (A). (B) geniş zaman, (C) gelecek zaman ve (D) sürerlik anlamı geçmiş cümleyle uyuşmaz. (E) would have left koşullu bir anlam katar.

options: the evidence was reviewed by the panel for two hours
the conclusion seemed unfounded to everyone
the panel concluded that the claim was unfounded
a claim was found unfounded by the panel
it was clear to everyone that the claim was unfounded
questions.explanationTR: Ortaç cümleciğinin öznesi ana cümlenin öznesi olmalıdır; kanıtları inceleyen taraf panelidir: (C). (A), (B), (D) ve (E) cümlelerinin öznesi (evidence, conclusion, claim, it) incelemeyi yapan taraf olmadığı için sarkan ortaç oluşur.

questions.prompt: Once the funds have been transferred, ----.
options: the project was able to start
the project will be able to start
the project had started
the project would start last week
the project has started
questions.explanationTR: «Once» ile kurulan zaman yan cümleciğinde present perfect gelecek zamana referans verir; ana cümle gelecek zamandadır: (B). (A) ve (C) ile (E) geçmiş ya da tamamlanmış bir eylemdir. (D) «last week» ile çelişir.

questions.prompt: The researchers repeated the experiment three times to ----.
options: confirming that the result was not a coincidence
confirmed that the result was not a coincidence
being confirmed that the result was not a coincidence
confirm that the result was not a coincidence
have been confirming that the result was not a coincidence
questions.explanationTR: «To» sonrası yalın fiil gelir ve amaç bildirir: to confirm that ...: (D). (A) confirming ve (B) confirmed ve (C) being confirmed to'dan sonra kullanılamaz. (E) have been confirming, mastar edatından sonra yanlış bir biçimdir.

questions.prompt: While the engineers were repairing the bridge, ----.
options: the bridge had collapsed the following winter
traffic was diverted through the old town
the engineers had finished their work the day before
the repairs will be completed in spring
traffic had never been so light
questions.explanationTR: «While» eşzamanlı iki eylemi bağlar: mühendisler köprüyü onarırken trafik eski şehirden yönlendirildi: (B). (A) ve (C) ile (D) zaman ilişkisini bozar. (E) «never» ile kurulan bir karşılaştırmadır ve bu bağlamda anlamsızdır.

options: applicants must check that every form has been signed
the form has been signed by every applicant
checking was done by every applicant
it is necessary that all forms had been checked by them
the deadline was extended by the office
questions.explanationTR: Ortaç cümleciğinin (submitting) öznesi ana cümlenin öznesi olmalıdır; başvuruyu yapan taraf başvuru sahipleridir: (A). (B) ve (C) ile (D) ve (E) öznesi başvuru yapan değildir (sarkan ortaç).

questions.prompt: She spoke quietly so as not to ----.
options: waking the sleeping children
woken the sleeping children
wake the sleeping children
be woken the sleeping children
have woken the sleeping children
questions.explanationTR: «So as not to» kalıbından sonra yalın fiil gelir: so as not to wake ...: (C). (A) waking ve (B) woken kalıba uymaz. (D) be woken nesne almaz. (E) have woken geçmişe dönük bir mastardır ve amaçla çelişir.

questions.prompt: The museum will lend the painting on condition that ----.
options: it was returned in perfect condition last year
it will be returning in perfect condition
returning it in perfect condition
it has been returned yesterday
it is returned in perfect condition by the end of the year
questions.explanationTR: «On condition that» bir şart cümleciği başlatır ve gelecek referans için geniş zaman ya da edilgen yapı kullanılır: it is returned ...: (E). (A) geçmişe ait bir durumdur. (B) yapı olarak yanlıştır. (C) cümlecik değildir. (D) «yesterday» ile gelecek şartı çelişir.

questions.prompt: He revised the manuscript twice before ----.
options: sent it to the publisher
he sending it to the publisher
to send it to the publisher
sending it to the publisher
was sent to the publisher
questions.explanationTR: «Before» bir edat gibi kullanıldığında ardından V-ing gelir: before sending it: (D). (A) sent çekimli bir fiildir ve özne eksiktir. (B) he sending yapıyı bozar. (C) to send edat sonrası kullanılamaz. (E) was sent özneyi değiştirir.
